title: Facing Fears
description: Plot: Active pursuit of Shadow Weaver, deeper investigation into his plans | Emotion: Fear transformed into courage, personal growth climax | Setting: Academy underground areas and Crystal Caves at Late that night, after the Shadow Weaver confrontation | Characters: Princess Luna, Princess Ruby, Princess Sage, All unicorn partners, Headmistress Aurora
lyrics:
I'm scared, I'll admit it
My heart's beating fast
I'm scared that I'm not strong enough
To make this moment last

I'm scared of the darkness
I'm scared of the unknown
I'm scared that when it matters most
I'll face it all alone

But I'm scared and I'll try anyway
I'm scared and I'll try
Because sometimes the bravest thing
Is to reach out when you cry

I know what it's like to feel
Like you don't belong
I know what it's like to think
That everything you do is wrong

I know what it's like to be
The different one, the strange
I know what it's like to hope
That somehow things will change

So I'm scared but I'll try anyway
I'm scared but I'll try
Because everyone deserves a friend
When they're ready to cry

LUNA:
Two years ago I lost my home
My family, my past

STARDUST:
But you found something stronger here

LUNA:
A friendship that will last

BOTH:
And if I can find belonging
In this magical place
Maybe I can help him find
Some healing and some grace

LUNA:
I'm scared but I'm not alone
My friends are by my side

RUBY:
We're scared but we'll try anyway

SAGE:
We won't run and hide

ALL THREE:
Because courage isn't fearless
Courage isn't strong
Courage is deciding
To keep going when things go wrong

LUNA (Solo, building to climax):
I'm scared of what we'll find down there
I'm scared of what he'll do
I'm scared that I'm not brave enough
To see this journey through

But I'm scared and I'll try anyway
I'm scared and I'll try
Because love is stronger than fear
And hope will never die

(Full voice, triumphant)
I'm scared but I'll try anyway
I'm scared but I'll try
I'm scared but I'll try anyway
And that's how heroes fly!
stage_directions: Character Development. The scene begins in the academy's underground areas - ancient stone corridors that extend beyond the hidden passages into natural cave systems. These are the Crystal Caves that lie beneath Rainbow Academy, where the Rainbow Crystal's power originates.. The caves are both beautiful and intimidating - crystalline formations catch and reflect light in spectacular ways, but the deeper passages are dark and unknown. Ancient magical energy pulses through the stone, and the air itself seems alive with power.
character_notes:
The scene begins in the academy's underground areas - ancient stone corridors that extend beyond the hidden passages into natural cave systems. These are the Crystal Caves that lie beneath Rainbow Academy, where the Rainbow Crystal's power originates.

The caves are both beautiful and intimidating - crystalline formations catch and reflect light in spectacular ways, but the deeper passages are dark and unknown. Ancient magical energy pulses through the stone, and the air itself seems alive with power.

This is dangerous territory - not just because of the Shadow Weaver's presence, but because the caves themselves are unpredictable, with shifting passages and magical phenomena that can disorient or trap the unwary.
